Meaning: The annual fine particle level the average person breathes
How calculated: Mean of 0.01 degree cells weighted by WorldPop 2022 people
How to read: Higher is worse; compare with WHO 5 and national 35

Meaning: The average over land, ignoring where people live
How calculated: Mean of cells weighted by cell area
How to read: Gap to the population-weighted value shows where people sit
Positive: people live in the dirtier parts of the area

Meaning: WHO stepping stones IT-4 to IT-1
How to read: IT-1 (35) is also Bangladesh's annual standard
Share above it is the main exceedance KPI
ug/m3 per year; robust to the 2018 spike

Meaning: Test for a steady upward or downward trend
How calculated: Hamed-Rao corrected for autocorrelation, BH-adjusted across units

Meaning: Trend as a share of the starting level
Worst month divided by cleanest month
How calculated: exp(max - min) of the STL seasonal component
How to read: Lower: winter and monsoon closer together

Meaning: How much an area resembles its neighbours
Local cluster type for one upazila
How to read: High-High: hot cluster; Low-Low: clean cluster

How calculated: Getis-Ord Gi* z-score with the upazila and its neighbours

Meaning: Regression that allows errors to cluster in space
How to read: Effect per 1 SD of a predictor

Meaning: Reduction needed to reach a target
Life expectancy lost relative to the WHO guideline
How calculated: 0.098 years per ug/m3 above 5, averaged over people, 2020-2024
How to read: An estimate from a published relationship, not a measured outcome

Meaning: Model test on whole regions held out
How to read: Lower than random CV when models lean on neighbours
